t: Im habberakot vehatteqiot meakkebot zo et zo
s: Im habberakot vehatteqiot meakkebot zo et zo ubo d' seipim: shalosh berakot sheomerim bemusap shel rosh hashshana shehen malkuyyot zikronot veshoparot meakkebot zo et zo, sheim eno yodea kol hashshalosh berakot — lo yomar kelum apillu otah beraka sheyyodea, abal berakot shel shear yemot hashshana en meakkebot zo et zo, ella im eno yodea kol habberakot — yomar hammiqtzat sheyyodea:
Seder habberakot meakkeb, sheim hiqdim lomar zikronot o shoparot lemalkuyyot o shoparot lezikronot — lo yatza:

Veken hatteqiot meakkebot zo et zo, sheim yodea litqoa veeno yodea leharia — lo yitqa kelum, lepi sheen kan mitzva kelal, ella im ken toqea umeria vetoqea g' peamim kemo shennitbaer besiman tq"tz. Abal im yodea leharia terua shellanu veeno yodea litqoa hashshebarim — yitqa tr"t g' peamim, veken im yodea litqoa shebarim veeno yodea hatterua shellanu — yitqa tsh"t g' peamim, deshemma mah shehu yodea zo hi terua haamura battora venimtza meqayyem hammitzva kemaamarah:

Hatteqiot sheal seder habberakot enan meakkebot et habberakot, sheim en bahem mi sheyyodea litqoa ap al pi ken yomar hashsheliach tzibbur kol hat' berakot, veken habberakot enan meakkebot et hatteqiot, sheim enan yodeim lebarek habberakot haellu ap al pi ken yitqeu g' sedarim. Im hitpalelu betzibbur hat' berakot velo taqeu ad leachar sheggamar hashsheliach tzibbur et hattepilla — yatzeu:
